task.title: Roll out node label changes safely without breaking node affinity scheduling
task.shortdesc: Update node labels and affinity rules in a controlled sequence to prevent sudden scheduling failures.

step.cmd: Inventory current workloads that use node affinity and list their required label keys and values.
Before changing labels, add new labels to nodes while keeping old labels in place temporarily.
Update workload manifests to accept both old and new labels using multiple values or multiple selector terms.
Roll out the workload changes and confirm new pods schedule successfully across updated nodes.
Remove old labels from nodes only after all workloads have been updated and verified.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
